svg.text: • Capacity Formula: With s = 4 pebble registers and recursion depth d = 4, maximum reversible windows is:

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: M_max(s=4, d=4) = Binomial(4 + 4, 4) - 1 = 70 - 1 = 69 Windows ≥ 32 GCD Windows.

svg.text: • Total Evaluations for M = 32: Exactly 77 Forward + 32 Reverse = 109 Window Evals (vs. 64 Naive = 1.70x total cost).
